records.failureSummary: Implemented the HTTP server, configuration bootstrap, shared JSON/error-envelope helpers, method+path router, and health endpoints as requested, wiring them into src/server.js while preserving the existing register-slice API contract and behavior. New modules: src/config.mjs (PORT default 3000 with range validation, DATA_DIR default ./data with blank/NUL rejection, ensureDataDir creates the directory on startup via recursive mkdir, loadConfig/ensureDataDir/bootstrap exports), src/http/responses.mjs (JSON_CONTENT_TYPE application/json, sendJson, errorEnvelope {error:{code,message}}, sendError, sendNoContent), src/http/router.mjs (createRouter with per-method route table, static literal matching plus ':param' support, decoded params, json 404 NOT_FOUND on unmatched method/path), src/health.mjs (HEALTH_PATHS /healthz,/health,/ready, isHealthPath, healthPayload, handleHealth returning 200 {"status":"ok"} with no auth and no DATA_DIR dependency), and src/server.js (createServer/getConfig/startServer, main-module guard, stdout-only startup log, no third-party dependencies). Zero new dependencies; all logging stays on stdout. Verification: node --test -> 42 tests, 35 passed, 7 failed, 0 errors; the 3 [AC-01] health tests all pass (exit codes and exact-body assertions validated via the spawned-server helper using temp DATA_DIR and random PORT). The 7 failures are [AC-04] persistence and [AC-06] concurrency tests owned by not-yet-implemented slices; npm run lint passed (17 modules scanned). npm run build fails inside another slice's script, not in these modules: it tries to read /workspace/workspace/src/server.js (double workspace prefix), which is outside my allowed file set.
